definitions.gloss: live broadcast; live relay; live coverage
definitions.explanation: A broadcast transmitted in real time as events happen, without recording or delay.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}は{生中継|なまちゅうけい}で{放送|ほうそう}される。
examples.english: The match will be broadcast live.

examples.japanese: {記者会見|きしゃかいけん}の{生中継|なまちゅうけい}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched the press conference live.

examples.japanese: オリンピックの{開会式|かいかいしき}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{生中継|なまちゅうけい}され、{数億人|すうおくにん}が{視聴|しちょう}した。
examples.english: The Olympic opening ceremony was broadcast live worldwide and watched by hundreds of millions.

notes:
{生中継|なまちゅうけい} is a compound of {生|なま} (live, raw) and {中継|ちゅうけい} (relay, broadcast). It can also be used as a する verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生中継|なまちゅうけい}する (to broadcast live)
- {生中継|なまちゅうけい}で{見|み}る (to watch live)
- {生中継|なまちゅうけい}で{放送|ほうそう}する (to air live)
- {衛星|えいせい}{生中継|なまちゅうけい} (satellite live broadcast)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中継|ちゅうけい}: relay, broadcast — may or may not be live
- {録画|ろくが}: recorded broadcast — the opposite of live
